import inspect
import io
import sys
import unittest
sys.path.insert(0, '.grok-stack')
from adaptive_grok import router
from tests.test_repo_router import OperationalIntentTests
original = router._has_operational_intent
source = inspect.getsource(original)
probes = (
    ('numeric-version-split-restored',
     r'[;\n!?]|(?<!\d)\.|\.(?!\d)|', r'[;\n.!?]|',
     'test_dotted_versions_and_bounded_historical_subjects_remain_review'),
    ('single-subject-restored',
     r'(?:(?!(?:that|which|who|котор\w*)\b)[\w.-]+\s+){0,3}',
     r'(?:[\w.-]+\s+)?',
     'test_dotted_versions_and_bounded_historical_subjects_remain_review'),
    ('russian-plan-context-disabled',
     r'\bплан(?:а|ы|ов)?', r'\bunsupported-plan-token',
     'test_russian_coordinated_plan_infinitives_remain_descriptive'),
)
all_killed = True
for name, fragment, replacement, test_name in probes:
    assert source.count(fragment) == 1, name
    namespace = dict(router.__dict__)
    exec(source.replace(fragment, replacement), namespace)
    router._has_operational_intent = namespace['_has_operational_intent']
    result = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO()).run(unittest.TestSuite([
        OperationalIntentTests(test_name),
    ]))
    killed = len(result.failures) == 2 and not result.errors
    print(name, 'killed' if killed else 'inconclusive/survived',
          'failures=', len(result.failures), 'errors=', len(result.errors))
    all_killed = all_killed and killed
router._has_operational_intent = original
print('developer in-memory probes; candidate files untouched')
raise SystemExit(0 if all_killed else 1)
PY
